data.name: AGE4_001
data.value: This should be the forest that the Guildmaster told us about.

data.name: AGE4_002

data.name: AGE4_003
data.value: {0}![pause=0] Finally!

data.value: A never before seen dungeon is right in front of us![pause=0] This is the kind of adventure I've been waiting for!

data.name: AGE4_005
data.value: I hope you're as excited about this as I am!

data.name: AGE4_006
data.value: I can't wait any longer![pause=0] Let's go explore this forest right now!

data.name: AGE4_007
data.value: Let's do our best on this,[pause=10] {0}!

data.value: Huh?

data.name: AGE4_011
data.value: Urk![pause=0] Seems like in this mystery dungeon,[pause=10] it's possible to go back the way we came.

data.name: AGE4_012
data.value: We'll have to be careful not to take the wrong way or we'll just end up back at the entrance!

data.name: AGE4_013

data.value: Last time we were here,[pause=10] we couldn't find anything of interest...

data.name: AGE4_017
data.value: But this time will be different![pause=0] I just know it!

data.name: AGE4_018
